================================================================================

================================================================================

All $ in USD billions unless noted. Tags: [Actual]/[Estimate]/[Assumption]/[Unconfirmed]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SECTION 0. ANALYSIS OVERVIEW
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
What it does (3 sentences): Instacart is a grocery marketplace connecting ~2,200
retail banners (~100,000 stores) to shoppers, monetized via transaction fees (7.2%
of GTV) and a fast-growing advertising/enterprise layer (2.9% of GTV) [Actual, PR].
It is now durably profitable (TTM NI $0.485B, Adj EBITDA 30% of revenue) and
cash-generative (TTM FCF $0.882B), returning the majority of FCF via buybacks
[Actual]. It is a Product-Platform Hybrid transitioning toward Quality Compounder.

UNDERSTANDABILITY: High.  MODEL CONFIDENCE: Medium-High (no segment data; 2 forward
EBITDA anchors [Unconfirmed]).

DATA-INTEGRITY FLAGS (judging the pack itself):
 1. FY2023 OI -$2.142B & SBC $2.756B = ONE-TIME IPO-YEAR SBC CHARGE, not a recurring
    business collapse. Excluding it, FY2023 OI ≈ +$0.61B. NOT a trend; do not
    extrapolate. [Actual + Estimate]
 2. Section 11 web brief is CONTAMINATED (mislabels CART as "Maplebear Inc." and an
    "industrial carts" market). I used ZERO numbers from it. All forward figures
    sourced from the company PR + filings. [Actual]
 3. Share count: current 233.035M vs FY2025 wtd-avg diluted 279.621M = BUYBACKS
    (-16.7%), NOT a split. The "split suspected: True" flag is a false trigger from
    the FY2023->FY2024 IPO issuance step (130.6M -> 289.2M). [Actual + Estimate]
 4. Vendor cash $0.637B (stale restatement) OVERRIDDEN by company PR "$1B cash and
    similar assets" at Q2 2026 quarter-end. [Actual]
 5. Segment revenue/margin: NONE held (Section 12). True SOTP impossible; using
    whole-company DCF + platform-premium overlay. [Unconfirmed]
 6. Q1 2026 and FY2025 exact Adjusted EBITDA: [Unconfirmed] (snippets cut off / not
    retrieved). Estimated and carried into ranges.

SECTION 1. MACRO CONTEXT
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1-1. Macro variable check (all retrieved, [Actual] unless noted):
 - 10Y Treasury: 4.74% (2026-08-21, tradingeconomics), DIRECTION UP (Bloomberg 8/19:
   "will top 5% this year"; 30Y at multi-decade highs). [Actual]

1-2. Regime distribution (must sum 100%):

 - Dollar:         +1 (mostly US-domestic; minor)

SECTION 1.5. BASE RATE CHECK
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 - Platform-transition success rate: ~20-30% (framework ref).

   CART is a profitable Hybrid, not option-led/cyclical/pre-revenue.)

 probability than the 20-30% base rate. 3 company-specific justifications:
   (1) Advertising is REAL revenue, 2.9% of GTV, +16% y/y (not narrative) [Actual];
   (2) Enterprise has named, scaling logos (Costco FoodStorm, Walmart, Weis,
       Wakefern, Morrisons, Dierbergs, Calgary Co-op) [Actual, PR];

 flag; no mandatory re-evaluation triggered.

SECTION 2. BUSINESS QUALITY (Buffett + Lynch)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

2-2. Moat score (0-3 each) + direction:

2-3. Lynch: FAST GROWER transitioning to STALWART. Checkpoints: sustainable growth
 (14% rev, decelerating to ~10% — OK), ROE 17.7% (good, not elite), competitive

2-5. Capital allocation (0-3 each, /15):

 5. Guidance accuracy: 2 (widened Q3 ranges; Q4 2025 EPS miss 30c vs 52c but rev beat)
 SUBTOTAL = 13/15. Insider bonus: insider 11.3% (>5% mgmt) +1; recent net buy/sell
 [Unconfirmed]. TOTAL ≈ 14/15. STRONG.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SECTION 2.5. INTANGIBLES-ADJUSTED FINANCIALS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2.5-1. R&D capitalization: R&D NOT separately disclosed (embedded in SG&A/COGS).
 CANNOT isolate; not capitalized separately. [Unconfirmed] (limitation noted).
2.5-2. SBC (the key adjustment): FY25 SBC $0.352B = 9.4% of rev [Actual]; TTM ≈
 $0.36B [Estimate]. Adjusted FCF = Reported FCF - SBC (full expense).
 - FY25: reported FCF $0.910B - SBC $0.352B = SBC-adj FCF $0.558B (margin 14.9%)
   [Estimate]
 - TTM: reported FCF $0.882B - SBC ~$0.36B = SBC-adj FCF ~$0.52B (margin ~13.5%)
   [Estimate]
2.5-3. Operating leases: FY25 $0.036B [Actual]; added to debt → net cash ≈ +$0.96B
 (negligible change).
2.5-4. Brand/data asset: data moat strong (90.3M orders/qtr); not reliably
 quantifiable. [Unconfirmed]
2.5-5. Adjusted ROIC (capitalizing SBC over 5y): Adj NOPAT = OI $0.498B + SBC
 $0.352B - amort $0.07B ≈ $0.78B; Adj IC = $2.77B + unamortized SBC ~$1.41B ≈

 SBC capitalization.
2.5-6. Owner earnings (Buffett): FY25 = NI $0.447B + D&A $0.091B - maint capex
 ~$0.05B - ΔWC (-$0.617B, a SOURCE) = $1.105B; SBC-adj = $0.753B [Estimate].
 CAUTION: FY25 owner earnings is INFLATED by the $0.617B working-capital release
 (not sustainable). Sustainable SBC-adj FCF run-rate ≈ $0.55-0.64B, NOT $1.1B.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SECTION 3. VALUATION — ENGINE 3 (HYBRID) × 60% + ENGINE 1 (QUALITY DCF) × 40%
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

0-3. Transition: Hybrid -> Quality Compounder criteria: (1) ROIC>WACC 3 consecutive
 yrs = NO (only FY24, FY25 solid; FY23 IPO-distorted); (2) installed-base
 monetization established = YES (advertising + enterprise). = 1 of 2 = 50% →
 BLENDED ENGINE (Engine 3 × 60% + Engine 1 × 40%), Conviction -0.5 steps.
0-4. Why: core marketplace is established/cash-generative (71% of revenue, GM 72%,
 FCF+ many qtrs) while advertising/enterprise are the platform premium. A pure
 Engine-1 DCF would under-value the advertising optionality; a pure Engine-4 would
 over-value it (it's already real revenue, not optionality). Segment split is
 [Unconfirmed], so I run a whole-company DCF (Engine-1 backbone) + platform-premium
 overlay (Engine-3 logic).

PLATFORM FEATURE SCORE (Engine 3): installed base (2,200 banners/100k stores)
 HIGH; recurring monetization (ads 2.9% GTV +16%, enterprise subs) HIGH and growing;

DISCOUNT-RATE DERIVATION (WACC):

 - Equity risk premium: 4.5% [Assumption, standard Damodaran]
 - Beta: 0.778 [Aggregator, vendor, unstated window] — LOW for a 14%-growing
   platform; I judge 0.9-1.0 more appropriate.
 - Cost of equity (beta 0.778) = 4.74 + 0.778×4.5 = 8.24% [Estimate]
 - Cost of equity (beta 1.0)   = 4.74 + 1.0×4.5   = 9.24% [Estimate]

CASH-FLOW DEFINITION: SBC-ADJUSTED FCF = Adj EBITDA - cash tax - capex - ΔNWC - SBC.

SECTION 4. SCENARIOS (BAYESIAN) — sum = 100%, base = highest prob
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Prior = Layer 1.5 base rates; updated by Q2 2026 beat + widened Q3 guide (likelihood

 My horizon: 5 yrs. Spread = 5 - 3.5 = 1.5 yrs (< 2 yrs) → NO clear horizon

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

5-2. Conviction decay: 0 (fresh). 5-3. Transition penalty: -0.5. NET ≈ 10/15 HIGH.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

SECTION 6. PORTFOLIO FIT
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Consumer Cyclical / Internet Retail. Fits growth + consumer allocation. Correlates
 with DASH, UBER, AMZN, consumer discretionary; LOW correlation with financials,
 energy, semis. Adds advertising-beta and grocery-necessity diversifiers.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SECTION 6.5. KELLY SIZING
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Expected total return: IV $61 vs $49.83 = +22.4% over 3-5y ≈ 4-5%/yr + buybacks
 (~3-4%/yr share-count reduction) ≈ 8-9%/yr.
 Win prob (base+bull) = 75%; loss (bear) = 25%. Payoff b = upside 71% / downside
 24% = 2.96. Full Kelly f* = (0.75×2.96 - 0.25)/2.96 = 66.6%. Use 1/4 Kelly = 17%.
 Reconcile with conviction cap (5-6%) + crowding (-1%p): BINDING CONSTRAINT =
 conviction/macro/crowding → FINAL 4-5%. (Kelly overstates: assumes precise 75% win
 prob and ignores the fat left tail of a rate-shock regime.) Layer-5 (5-6%) vs
 1/4-Kelly (17%) gap ≈ 11-12%p < 20%p → no re-analysis required (Rule 13).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SECTION 7. RISKS & CATALYSTS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
THESIS-INTEGRITY (re-evaluation) TRIGGERS:
 - GTV growth < 8% for 2 consecutive qtrs (deceleration beyond plan).
 - Take rate (rev/GTV) < 9.5% (advertising not scaling).
 - Adj EBITDA margin < 28% (compression).
 - SBC > 10% of revenue (dilution outpacing buybacks).
 - Net cash turns to net debt.
 - Multiple compresses below 7x EBITDA.
CATALYSTS: Q3 2026 print (GTV $10,425M mid, EBITDA $330M mid [Actual guide]);
 advertising take-rate expansion; enterprise logos (Costco FoodStorm, Walmart);
 AI (Gemini, AI assistant lifting the $115 AOV); buyback acceleration.
PRE-MORTEM (3 failure modes + early warnings):

    < GTV growth.
 2. Growth stall (penetration plateau) → GTV < 8%, orders < 5%; multiple de-rates.
 3. SBC/dilution spiral → SBC > 10% of rev, share count flat/rising, no per-share
    FCF growth.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SECTION 7.5. CORRELATION-ADJUSTED RISK
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Common portfolio bear trigger: HIGH RATES / LIQUIDITY TIGHTENING (de-rates the
 multiple). If the book holds other long-duration growth (DASH, UBER, PLTR), they

 stocks correlated ~0.8-0.9. CONDITIONAL VaR: a 2022-style shock could take CART
 from $51 to ~$25-30 (-40 to -50%). Position sizing already reflects this (4-5%,

 rev/GTV vs 10.1%; (3) Adj EBITDA margin vs 30%; (4) SBC % of rev vs 9%; (5) net

SECTION 9. RED TEAM & ADVERSARIAL
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 3. Growth is DECELERATING (14% now → Street 9-10% by 2027); "acceleration" fading.
 4. Competition: DoorDash, Walmart, Amazon all have scale and are encroaching.
 5. Valuation: 20x fwd, 17-19x SBC-adj FCF is not cheap for a decelerating grower.
 6. Macro: 10Y 4.74% and RISING is a direct multiple headwind.
 7. FY23 "profitability" was flattered by a one-time SBC charge; underlying opex is
    high (FY23 SG&A $0.803B).
9-2. LOGIC COMBAT: Long stronger on business quality (wide moat, real FCF, buybacks,
 18% MoS); Short stronger on valuation/macro (take-rate cap, SBC, deceleration,
 rates). Gap ≈ 1.5-2 (near the downgrade threshold) → conviction held at High, NOT
 raised.
9-3. ADVERSARIAL DATA: No current Hindenburg/activist report found in retrieved
 sources (pack's Section 11 activist note is 2020-dated and contaminated). [Unconfirmed]

 - "Walmart crushes it" — killed by 2,200 banners + enterprise lock-in; revives if
   Walmart's marketplace poaches banners.
 - "SBC is non-cash, ignore it" — killed by framework rule + 9.4% magnitude; revives
